description: Return the simulation workspace this credential is connected to to its baseline, the client's data before anything was rehearsed (governed two-step, destructive): rehearsed records, the simulated books' postings and the captured QuickBooks requests go, and the simulated clock returns to real time. The next run saves a fresh baseline. Never touches QuickBooks. Requires a credential granted the sandbox.reset capability. Call with preview=true first, confirm with the user, then repeat with the previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey. Committing needs Spark's OAuth connector: in Sparki the preview works but the commit is refused, so reset from the simulated books page instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to receive what the reset replaces plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call, with a fresh idempotencyKey.

name: reset_simulation_workspace
title: Reset Simulation Workspace
